At Evotec’s site in Hamburg, Germany, we are seeking a highly motivated and dedicated

LAS Veterinarian (all genders)

Pre-clinical Research, Drug Development and Biomarker Discovery

Permanent, part time (min. 20h/week)

The Laboratory Animal Science (LAS) Veterinarian is responsible for overseeing the health, welfare, and humane use of laboratory animals, primarily mice and rats, within a CRO environment. This role ensures compliance with European and German regulatory standards while supporting pre-clinical research activities. The successful candidate will work closely with study directors, technicians, veterinarians, the Animal Welfare Officer (AWO), and quality teams to enable high-quality, ethical, and compliant research.

Responsibilities:

- Provide veterinary care and oversight for laboratory animals, primarily mice and rats
- Contribute to the cross-site veterinary team and support harmonization of veterinary practices
- Support laboratory animal science activities and scientific research programs
- Discuss animal permit applications and regulatory requirements with scientists
- Participate in the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC)
- Attend and contribute to face-to-face and virtual meetings with colleagues across sites
- Collaborate closely with teams responsible for in vivo models as well as pharmacology and toxicology project leaders
- Assist in the review of study protocols, study designs, data, and reports
- Support the evaluation, validation, and implementation of new techniques, tools, readouts, models, methods, equipment, and platforms
- Stay current with scientific developments, new technologies, and best practices in laboratory animal science through continuous education and participation in scientific meetings
- Ensure accurate reporting of animal numbers in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements
- Assume responsibility for the veterinary pharmacy

Qualifications:

- Doctorate in Veterinary Medicine (DVM / Dr. med. vet.); board certification as a Veterinary Laboratory Animal Science specialist (Fachtierarzt für Versuchstierkunde) is highly desirable
- Sound knowledge of European and German animal welfare regulations, including Directive 2010/63/EU, the German Animal Welfare Act (TierSchG), and the 3Rs principle
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams
- Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills

Further ideal qualifications and competencies:

- FELASA Category C certification or equivalent is an advantage
- Experience working within AAALAC-accredited environments is beneficial
- Practical experience with surgical procedures, such as implantations and model induction, is desirable
- Scientific mindset with strong analytical skills and awareness of potential sources of bias and error
- Strong commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing
- High level of dedication to animal welfare, ethical research practices, and regulatory compliance
- Detail-oriented working style with a focus on quality and accurate documentation

Our Offer

- A position within a vigorous and exciting professional environment promoted by an open culture and a spirit of community
- A diverse, international workforce with a dynamic working environment that fosters creativity, innovations and teamwork
- 30 days of annual holiday, monthly allowance for public transportation, and in-house canteen
- Capital forming benefits, flexible working hours, holiday pay, and annual bonus depending on performance

To apply, please click on the “Apply” button and provide your application documents (CV and cover letter, including earliest possible start date and salary requirements). We are looking forward to getting to know you and to your application.

FR : Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, Evotec étudie, à compétences égales, toutes les candidatures dont celles des personnes en situation de handicap.

ENG : In the frame of our Diversity policy, Evotec considers, with equal competences, all applications including people with disabilities.

Welcome to the IT Security team at Fresenius Digital Technology! We are responsible for the implementation, management and operation of programs, projects and services for a wide range of different security capabilities in various business segments within the Fresenius Group.

We are looking for a highly motivated team member who will ensure that security controls for AI platforms and models are thoughtfully designed, continuously maintained, and fully embedded into engineering and operational processes. You will work closely with enabling teams across the CISO pillars, leveraging existing security services and enhancing them with AI-specific capabilities and patterns.

You can look forward to a working environment that is as challenging as it is attractive. One that fits the ideal of a top workplace in so many respects - while expanding our own expert skills bank.

Join us as an AI Security Lead (m/f/d).

Your responsibilities:

- Design, implement, and continuously maintain security controls covering AI platforms, models, data pipelines, and inference environments
- Embed AI-specific security requirements into engineering, MLOps, and day-to-day operational processes
- Partner with SOC/CERT, IAM, Cloud Security, Platform Security and Security Management to extend existing security services with AI-specific capabilities and patterns, rather than building parallel structures
- Establish consistent, scalable security patterns and guardrails for AI use cases to prevent fragmented or inconsistent risk treatment across business units
- Act as the enterprise point of expertise on emerging AI risks (model poisoning, data leakage, adversarial inputs, misuse of generative outputs), proactively identifying and mitigating them before they materialize into incidents
- Collaborate with different stakeholders in the group to integrate AI security controls into enterprise AI/ML platforms and CI/CD pipelines

Your qualifications:

- Deep experience in designing, operating, and scaling enterprise security controls, with strong operational ownership and seamless integration into SOC/CERT, IAM, cloud, and CI/CD environments
- Strong understanding of AI/ML platforms (data pipelines, model training, inference, model repositories) and AI-specific threats such as model poisoning, data leakage, adversarial inputs, and misuse of generative outputs
- Proven ability to embed AI security controls into enterprise platforms and workflows
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML security techniques, tools, or frameworks such as adversarial ML, model scanning, AI guardrails, MITRE ATLAS, and secure AI lifecycle approaches
- Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging regulations such as the EU AI Act, with experience translating these into practical technical controls
- Experience shaping multi-year security capability roadmaps, building investment cases, and managing specialist vendors delivering AI security tooling and services
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, as well as strong analytical skills and an independent, responsible work style
- Business-fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage

Our offer

Join #futurefresenius and become part of a challenging and attractive working environment that fits the ideal of a top workplace in many respects, while expanding your expert skills.

Contact

Apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=106724&tc=3-11)

The Group IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation department is the driving force behind shaping and executing the One IT vision across the organization.

Through Enterprise Architecture Management, IT Governance, and Service Management, the department fosters collaboration, enforces governance policies, and harmonizes IT processes across the group.

To strengthen our team we are looking for a senior ITSM Process Owner (m/f/d) – a senior ITSM professional who is accountable for the design, documentation, performance, and continuous improvement of one or more IT Service Management processes across Fresenius Digital Technology. You will ensure end-to-end ownership, ITIL best practices, and compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements.

Your responsibilities:

- Own and maintain the assigned ITSM process, including process objectives, policies, inputs, outputs, interfaces, KPIs, and quality attributes
- Ensure conformity with ITIL, legal, audit and contractual requirements
- Drive process harmonization and standardization across segments
- Maintain all process-related documentation (SOPs, WIs, training content)
- Define, monitor, and report process performance through KPIs; ensure transparency and timely updates on risks, dependencies, and progress
- Ensure integration across ITSM practices
- Own process maturity roadmap and improvements
- Lead stakeholder alignment and communication
- Provide expert guidance and training

Your qualifications:

- At least 5 years of experience in ITSM or governance roles
- Proven experience in IT Service Management, ITIL-based process ownership, process modelling (BPMN 2.0), and governance frameworks
- Hands-on experience with ServiceNow (especially ITSM e.g SPM, Catalog, Incident/Problem workflows)
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills as well as cross-segment alignment capability and organizational awareness
- Analytical mindset, problem-solving skills, ability to manage conflicting priorities
- Strong analytical and process engineering skills
- Business fluent German and English (written and spoken)

Our offer

Drive the future of our IT Service Management - join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Contact

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=108214&tc=3-11)

As Project Controller (m/f/d), you will support our team in project controlling, vendor management and operational controlling processes.

Your focus will be on supporting projects from a financial controlling perspective, including forecasting, reporting and monthly charging processed. In close collaboration with stakeholders across global and local controlling across market units, project teams, and external Partners, you ensure transparency and consistency in project reporting while contributing to the continuous improvement of reporting structures and controlling processes.

The role combines analytical work, operational coordination and hands-on process improvement in a dynamic finance environment.

Major Duties & Responsibilities:

- Support project controlling activities end-to-end: Prepare actuals vs. plan/forecast analyses, monitor project cost development, and support recurring project reporting and ad-hoc evaluations for ongoing projects and cost structures
- Support vendor management activities: Across the full project lifecycle, support in cost tracking, forecasting, reporting, and coordination of external partners, including the support in Statement of Work (SOW) related activities.
- Contribute to a holistic project reporting: Help align financial and project reporting in a consistent and transparent structure across projects and stakeholders (ideally with BI components)
- Perform recurring quality checks: Identify inconsistencies, coordinate corrections with relevant stakeholders and help ensure that financial structures remain accurate and up to date. This also includes the maintenance and validation of key controlling and master data, including project-related structures and financial dimensions such as cost centers, profit centers and WBS elements.
- Act as the interface between the controlling team, project team and market units: Support stable and reliable monthly charging and license allocation processes, ensuring timely and accurate execution of recurring charging activities, including validation, reconciliation and reporting of (license-related) charges.
- Contribute to the further development of reporting standards, charging concepts and controlling processes, including participation in strategic discussions around allocation methodologies and reporting structures.
- Maintain process documentation, user guidance and training materials: Ensure transparency, consistency and efficient onboarding for relevant project controlling processes.
- Support users and stakeholders in operational topics: Help resolve day-to-day issues related to reporting structures, hierarchies, project-related data and system usage.
- Support the preparation of management reports and analysis for finance and business stakeholders.
- Contribute to process improvement initiatives: Gather business requirements, structure them into clear concepts and coordinate implementation with internal stakeholders and IT where needed.
- Collaborate across functions: Work closely with colleagues in Controlling and project teams to improve data consistency, reporting reliability and the efficiency of end-to-end finance processes.

Requisite Qualification & Experience:

- Education: Completed university degree in Finance, Business or a comparable qualification (ideally Master Studies).
- Experience: At least 2 years relevant practical experience in controlling, finance, reporting, project controlling, through internships, working student roles or initial full-time experience.
- Functional know-how: Good understanding of controlling, accounting and reporting processes, ideally with first exposure to project-related financial steering and reporting structures.
- Analytical capability: Strong analytical skills, a structured way of working and high attention to detail, especially when working with financial data and system-based information.
- Systems and tools: Very good MS Office skills, especially Excel; Experience working with systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Veeva and IQVIA in the context of project controlling is considered a plus.
- Strong AI competencies: curious and proliferate in using AI to increase efficiency, create work excellence and improve processes
- Working style: Reliable, independent and hands-on, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and follow through on operational topics.
- Communication: Strong communication skills and confidence in working with different stakeholders and functions.
- Languages: Business-fluent English is required; German is an advantage.
- Mindset: Energetic, improvement-driven and curious, with the ambition to challenge existing ways of working, identify better solutions and contribute beyond pure task execution.

Our offer

Drive the future of our company — join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Contact

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=108270&tc=3-11)

The Process Architect Plan-to-Produce (m/f/d) supports the Process Owner and Global Process Owner in defining future-state business processes, translating business requirements into solution designs, and ensuring the successful deployment of standardized end-to-end production processes across all manufacturing sites.

Your responsibilities:

- Translate business needs from manufacturing sites into clear process requirements, functional specifications, user requirements, and solution design inputs.
- Collaborate with Solution Architects, IT teams, MES experts, Quality, Warehouse Operations, Planning, and Production stakeholders to design scalable, compliant, and standardized SAP S/4HANA PP-PI processes.
- Support Fit-to-Template workshops, design validation, and decision preparation for template deviations or local requirements.
- Define and maintain process models, process flows, business rules, and documentation for Level 2 and Level 3 Plan-to-Produce processes, ensuring alignment with end-to-end value streams.
- Contribute to master data governance for production-relevant objects such as BOMs, master recipes, routings, work centers/resources, production versions, and planning parameters, in collaboration with Global Data Stewards.
- Support the definition of data migration concepts, cleansing rules, validation checks, and mock-load activities to ensure high data quality for production master data.
- Support test strategy and execution, including preparation of test scenarios, OQ/PQ documentation, defect clarification, business validation, and coordination of site testing activities.
- Deliver process and system training, and support user adoption during deployment, hypercare, and continuous improvement phases.
- Identify process risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and support the Process Owner in prioritization, decision tracking, and project management activities.

Your qualifications:

- University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems, Life Sciences, or a comparable field.
- At least 5 years of relevant experience in production, business process management, ERP transformation, or process architecture, preferably in the pharmaceutical, MedTech, nutrition, or other regulated industry.
- Strong end-to-end understanding of Plan-to-Produce processes, including production planning, production execution, shop-floor operations, quality integration, warehouse integration, and master data dependencies.
- Hands-on knowledge of SAP S/4HANA manufacturing capabilities, including PP-PI, Fiori apps, and related cross-functional integration points.
- Solid understanding of production master data objects.
- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex process dependencies and propose pragmatic, standardized solutions.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with global, cross-functional, and site-based teams.
- High learning agility, adaptability to evolving business requirements and technologies, and strong motivation to drive harmonization and continuous improvement.
- Business fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%, depending on project and deployment needs.

Our offer

Drive the future of our company — join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!

Contact

Apply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107202&tc=3-11)

The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. TheGWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expresslyencouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail:

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).

jobs.occupation: Business Development Specialist - Biomonitoring (all genders) - BY, BW, NRW (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

Microbiological contamination control is at the heart of pharmaceutical manufacturing quality — and in this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding a cutting-edge portfolio of microbiological testing and automation solutions across key German markets. You will take full ownership of a defined territory, developing and executing a strategic account plan that targets new customer acquisition, deepens existing relationships, and positions the portfolio as the partner of choice within the pharmaceutical and biotech sector.

You will engage consultatively with technical and commercial stakeholders across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations, guiding them through high-value capital investment decisions with clarity and credibility. By combining deep microbiological expertise with a structured approach to pipeline management, you will identify untapped market opportunities, introduce advanced automation and robotics solutions, and deliver measurable revenue growth. Your ability to navigate long sales cycles and translate technical value into business outcomes will be central to your success in this role.

Who you are:

- You bring at least 5 years of field sales experience in pharmaceutical quality control, production, or a closely related life science sector, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets in complex business-to-business environments.
- You hold academic degree in microbiology, biology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience); knowledge of laboratory automation or robotics is a strong advantage.
- You have in-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical quality control and production environments, including familiarity with Good Manufacturing Practice guidelines, Annex 1 and cleanroom or aseptic processing requirements.
- You are experienced in managing high-value, long-cycle capital expenditure sales processes, including stakeholder mapping across complex organizational structures and engagement at management level.
- You are fluent in German (C2) and English (C1); an established professional network within the German pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is highly advantageous.
- You hold a valid driver’s license and are willing to spend the majority of your working time in the field across Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, and North Rhine-Westphalia; candidates based within these regions are preferred.
- You demonstrate strong negotiation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage credibly across both technical and commercial functions.
- You have a proven ability to manage territory, spending over 70% of time in the field, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and you are highly self-directed and results-oriented, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management and territory planning.
- You are familiar with artificial intelligence concepts and tools, including their practical applications and limitations, and are able to apply this understanding to evaluate and use AI-supported solutions responsibly in a commercial context.

Location

Germany (Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg, North Rhine-Westphalia) | Field-based with regional travel

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology.
